# ex: needParen with binary expression replacement in binary context
ex {
	var x, y int
	x + y -> x * y
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(a, b, c int) int {
	return a + b + c
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

 func F(a, b, c int) int {
-	return a + b + c
+	return (a * b) * c
 }
